notes: South side from the Queyras as in the app ('beginnt nach dem Abzweig bei Château-Queyras'): km 0 = the junction where the D902 Route de l'Izoard leaves the Guil valley road (D947) about 2 km west of Château-Queyras (~1360 m; app 1370 m). The app's Arvieux at 3.7 km and length 14.2 km both match this foot (routed 3.9 km to Arvieux centre and 14.24 km to the col). cols-cyclisme lists a longer 15.9 km version starting lower in the Gorges du Guil; not used. Route: D902 via Les Moulins, Arvieux, La Chalp, Brunissard, the hairpins in the larch forest, the Casse Déserte (short descent ~11.6-12.0 km, low point ~2185 m) and the summit hairpins to the col (2360 m; one road only, no alternatives). km values = routed distance on Overture roads scaled by 14.2/14.243. Hamlet points are where the D902 passes them (Overture locality positions snapped to the road). The Coppi/Bobet stele position is approximate (medium).
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 transportation segments (D902 Route de l'Izoard / Route du Col d'Izoard) and divisions (Les Moulins, Arvieux, La Chalp, Brunissard)
